text:
Alice M.: Heads-up — planning to enable pioneer-7b-v2 in the model catalog (eu region) tomorrow during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Canary plan: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then ramp to full if metrics look good. Fallback ordering will be: pioneer-7b-v1 -> pioneer-6b-quant -> alf-7b. Pin list will include enterprise customers and `beta-.*` prefixes. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/pioneer-7b-v2 :rocket:

Ben K.: Quick question — what's the perf delta vs v1 we saw on eu-west2?

Alice M.: median +12ms, p95 +40ms (eu-west2 profile). Memory usage slightly higher on long sequences, but within safety margins. We ran a quick eval sweep vs our regression set; no quality drop in sampled prompts.

Carla R.: Can we set a no-fallback flag for high-priority tenants (enterprise) so they stay pinned to v1 until we confirm? Also who owns rollback decision?

Alice M.: Yes — will add explicit no-fallback entries in the pin manifest for enterprise customers. Rollback owner during the window: @Frank P. primary, @Ethan L. backup. I'm the release lead for the catalog change.

deploy-bot: Scheduled catalog-enable job created (id: job-2410001111-01). Command: ```/catalog-enable --model pioneer-7b-v2 --canary 5 --canary-duration 30m --region eu --change-window 2026-03-21T02:00Z```

Ben K.: What are the automated rollback triggers we should rely on?

Alice M.: Rollback thresholds: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regression > 20% vs baseline across production routes. Also any crashloop signals from runtime or KV cache thrash. Quality alerts from the eval hook will also mark for manual rollback.

Alice M.: Rollback command (manual): ```/catalog-rollback --job job-2410001111-01 --to pioneer-7b-v1 --reason "latency/regression"```

Ethan L.: I'll own metrics during the window and will trigger rollback if thresholds hit. I'll have dashboards pinned and a small watch doc.

Frank P.: I'll coordinate on-call rotation and paging. Adding #eng-oncall and #support to the watchlist. Also will run a dry-run of the rollback command before the window to validate playbooks.

Carla R.: Can we add a short note in the release notes about fallback ordering and pin behavior so support has a quick troubleshooting pointer?

Alice M.: Yep — will append a "fallback & pinning" section to the release notes and post a short runbook snippet to #support.

deploy-bot: job-2410001111-01 queued. To cancel before start: ```/job-cancel job-2410001111-01```

Ben K.: LGTM.

Carla R.: ack.

Ethan L.: on it, will be live-monitoring.

Frank P.: ready to roll, will stand by for alerts.

Alice M.: Thanks all — I'll post final preflight tomorrow 30m before the window and then a post-cutover summary in #announcements.
